description.en: Home Assistant on the panel, live over its WebSocket API: any entity in big with its history, lists of entities, what needs you at home (doors left open, low batteries, leaks, the alarm) and your cameras' latest pictures.
description.es: Home Assistant en el panel, en directo por su API WebSocket: cualquier entidad en grande con su histórico, listas de entidades, lo que te necesita en casa (puertas abiertas, baterías bajas, fugas, la alarma) y la última imagen de tus cámaras.

description.en: One Home Assistant entity in big: a temperature, the power the house draws, a door, the thermostat. Numeric sensors can show their last hours as bars, and turn amber or red past thresholds of your own.
description.es: Una entidad de Home Assistant en grande: una temperatura, lo que consume la casa, una puerta, el termostato. Los sensores numéricos pueden mostrar sus últimas horas en barras y ponerse en ámbar o rojo al pasar los umbrales que elijas.

entity.title: Entity
entity.description: Its id, as in Home Assistant → Settings → Devices & services → Entities.

help.en: Its id, as in Home Assistant → Settings → Devices & services → Entities.
help.es: Su id, como en Home Assistant → Ajustes → Dispositivos y servicios → Entidades.

name.title: Name
name.description: Empty = the name in Home Assistant.

help.en: Empty = the name in Home Assistant.
help.es: Vacío = el nombre en Home Assistant.

showHistory.title: Show the history
showHistory.description: Numeric sensors only, when the source keeps their history.

help.en: Numeric sensors only, when the source keeps their history.
help.es: Solo sensores numéricos cuyo histórico guarda la fuente.

decimals.title: Decimals
decimals.description: -1 = automatic: fewer as the number grows.

help.en: -1 = automatic: fewer as the number grows.
help.es: -1 = automático: menos cuanto mayor es el número.

alert.title: Alert (red) at
alert.description: Red, and the widget keeps its tile.

help.en: Red, and the widget keeps its tile.
help.es: Rojo, y el widget se queda con su tesela.

description.en: A list of Home Assistant entities and their states, picked by id or name with patterns (sensor.*_temperature, light.*). Open doors, low batteries and alarms are coloured; the rest stays quiet.
description.es: Una lista de entidades de Home Assistant con sus estados, elegidas por id o nombre con patrones (sensor.*_temperature, light.*). Puertas abiertas, baterías bajas y alarmas llevan color; el resto, discreto.

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: 0 = as many as fit. A number shows that many, in rows of a readable size (fewer when the tile is too small for them); the rest are counted in "+N more".

help.en: 0 = as many as fit. A number shows that many, in rows of a readable size (fewer when the tile is too small for them); the rest are counted in "+N more".
help.es: 0 = las que quepan. Con un número se ven esas, en filas de un tamaño legible (menos si la tesela no da para ellas); el resto se cuenta en «+N más».

layout.title: Row layout
layout.description: Automatic: the widget picks by the tile's shape.

help.en: Automatic: the widget picks by the tile's shape.
help.es: Automático: el widget elige según la forma de la tesela.

entities.title: Entities
entities.description: Ids or names, in the order to list them: sensor.*_temperature, light.*, *kitchen*, !light.porch. Empty = all.

help.en: Ids or names, in the order to list them: sensor.*_temperature, light.*, *kitchen*, !light.porch. Empty = all.
help.es: Ids o nombres, en el orden en que listarlas: sensor.*_temperature, light.*, *cocina*, !light.porch. Vacío = todas.

hideOff.title: Only what is on, open or wrong
hideOff.description: Leaves out what is off or closed. Numbers always stay.

label.en: Only what is on, open or wrong
label.es: Solo lo encendido, abierto o con problemas

help.en: Leaves out what is off or closed. Numbers always stay.
help.es: Deja fuera lo apagado o cerrado. Los números se quedan siempre.

help.en: -1 = automatic.
help.es: -1 = automático.

description.en: Only what needs you at home: smoke, a leak or the alarm in red (and it keeps its tile until they stop), then doors and windows left open, unlocked locks, low batteries and problems. Hides itself when all is well.
description.es: Solo lo que te necesita en casa: humo, una fuga o la alarma en rojo (y se queda con su tesela hasta que paren), luego puertas y ventanas abiertas, cerraduras sin cerrar, baterías bajas y problemas. Se oculta cuando todo va bien.

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: 0 = as many as fit. A number shows that many, in rows of a readable size (fewer when the tile is too small for them); the rest are counted in "+N more".

help.en: 0 = as many as fit. A number shows that many, in rows of a readable size (fewer when the tile is too small for them); the rest are counted in "+N more".
help.es: 0 = las que quepan. Con un número se ven esas, en filas de un tamaño legible (menos si la tesela no da para ellas); el resto se cuenta en «+N más».

layout.title: Row layout
layout.description: Automatic: the widget picks by the tile's shape.

help.en: Automatic: the widget picks by the tile's shape.
help.es: Automático: el widget elige según la forma de la tesela.

entities.title: Entities
entities.description: Empty = all. Leave out the ones that are fine open with !: !binary_sensor.patio_door.

help.en: Empty = all. Leave out the ones that are fine open with !: !binary_sensor.patio_door.
help.es: Vacío = todas. Deja fuera con ! las que pueden estar abiertas: !binary_sensor.patio_door.

includeOpenings.title: Doors, windows and locks
includeOpenings.description: Open doors, windows, garage doors and gates; unlocked locks.

help.en: Open doors, windows, garage doors and gates; unlocked locks.
help.es: Puertas, ventanas, garajes y cancelas abiertas; cerraduras sin cerrar.

openMs.title: Open for at least
openMs.description: A door counts once it has been open this long. 0 = at once.

help.en: A door counts once it has been open this long. 0 = at once.
help.es: Una puerta cuenta cuando lleva abierta este tiempo. 0 = al momento.

includeProblems.title: Problems
includeProblems.description: Problem and tamper sensors, lost connections, a vacuum in error.

help.en: Problem and tamper sensors, lost connections, a vacuum in error.
help.es: Sensores de problema y manipulación, conexiones perdidas, un robot aspirador en error.

description.en: The latest picture of a Home Assistant camera (Blink, Reolink, ONVIF…), refreshed every minute, with how old it is; with a motion sensor, a red mark while it sees someone, and it can take over its tile. A still, not live video.
description.es: La última imagen de una cámara de Home Assistant (Blink, Reolink, ONVIF…), refrescada cada minuto, con su antigüedad; con un sensor de movimiento, una marca roja mientras ve a alguien, y puede quedarse con su tesela. Una foto, no vídeo en directo.

entity.title: Camera
entity.description: Its id in Home Assistant: camera.something.

help.en: Its id in Home Assistant: camera.something.
help.es: Su id en Home Assistant: camera.algo.

name.title: Name
name.description: Empty = the name in Home Assistant.

help.en: Empty = the name in Home Assistant.
help.es: Vacío = el nombre en Home Assistant.

showAge.title: Show how old the picture is
showAge.description: Since the picture last changed. A battery camera (Blink) only takes a new one on motion or when asked.

label.en: Show how old the picture is
label.es: Mostrar la antigüedad de la imagen

help.en: Since the picture last changed. A battery camera (Blink) only takes a new one on motion or when asked.
help.es: Desde que cambió la imagen por última vez. Una cámara de batería (Blink) solo hace otra con movimiento o cuando se le pide.

motion.title: Motion sensor
motion.description: Empty = binary_sensor.<camera>_motion if there is one (Blink names them so).

help.en: Empty = binary_sensor.<camera>_motion if there is one (Blink names them so).
help.es: Vacío = binary_sensor.<cámara>_motion si existe (Blink los llama así).

keep.title: Keep in view
keep.description: What filling crops last: the sky or the ground.

help.en: What filling crops last: the sky or the ground.
help.es: Lo último que recorta al llenar: el cielo o el suelo.

dim.title: Darken
dim.description: Keeps a bright picture from outshining everything else.

help.en: Keeps a bright picture from outshining everything else.
help.es: Para que una imagen clara no deslumbre al resto.

description.en: The states of your Home Assistant entities, live over its WebSocket API (a change shows at once), and the last day of the numeric sensors for the history bars.
description.es: Los estados de las entidades de tu Home Assistant, en directo por su API WebSocket (un cambio se ve al momento), y el último día de los sensores numéricos para las barras de histórico.

url.title: Home Assistant address
url.description: The one you open in the browser, e.g. http://homeassistant.local:8123 or https://home.example.com.

help.en: The one you open in the browser, e.g. http://homeassistant.local:8123 or https://home.example.com.
help.es: La que abres en el navegador, p. ej. http://homeassistant.local:8123 o https://casa.example.com.

token.title: Long-lived access token
token.description: In Home Assistant: your profile → Security → Long-lived access tokens → Create token. A user that is not an administrator is enough. Secret: leave it empty (or a placeholder such as "<token>"). Kiosko keeps the value it already has, or asks for it in the editor.

label.es: Token de acceso de larga duración

help.en: In Home Assistant: your profile → Security → Long-lived access tokens → Create token. A user that is not an administrator is enough.
help.es: En Home Assistant: tu perfil → Seguridad → Tokens de acceso de larga duración → Crear token. Basta un usuario que no sea administrador.

entities.title: Entities to read
entities.description: Empty = all. Ids or names, with * and !: sensor.*, binary_sensor.*, lock.*, !sensor.*_linkquality.

help.en: Empty = all. Ids or names, with * and !: sensor.*, binary_sensor.*, lock.*, !sensor.*_linkquality.
help.es: Vacío = todas. Ids o nombres, con * y !: sensor.*, binary_sensor.*, lock.*, !sensor.*_linkquality.

history.title: Entities with history
history.description: Numeric sensors whose last day is kept for the history bars. Empty = every one with a unit.

help.en: Numeric sensors whose last day is kept for the history bars. Empty = every one with a unit.
help.es: Sensores numéricos de los que se guarda el último día para las barras de histórico. Vacío = todos los que tienen unidad.

maxHistory.title: Most entities with history
maxHistory.description: Each costs a day of five-minute averages in memory (about 300 numbers). 0 = no history.

help.en: Each costs a day of five-minute averages in memory (about 300 numbers). 0 = no history.
help.es: Cada una ocupa un día de medias de cinco minutos en memoria (unos 300 números). 0 = sin histórico.
